surface_verification.detail: The real CLI driven as a subprocess against real git repositories: stamp -> git add -> commit -> --verify-commit, the adversarial writer between stamp and commit, the commitless-repository path, and the Group E remedy's first step. Reads blobs out of the COMMIT, not the worktree.

behaviors.behavior: AC-1 the supplied base reaches every markdown evidence banner
AC-1 an existing run id survives stamping
AC-2 absent / literal HEAD / malformed / non-resolving base all yield no_base, nothing written
AC-2 an abbreviated base is REFUSED (git resolves a short id as a ref first, which would stamp a real-but-wrong commit)
AC-2 a padded base is still accepted (validate the trimmed value, send the trimmed value)
AC-2 this mode never resolves HEAD - asserted over both module objects, by substring, and by never reaching git at all
AC-3 a stale release= is removed rather than inherited
A present but banner-less document yields partial, a non-zero exit, and an untouched tree
An INCOMPLETE set stops the adoption whether or not a base resolves (the no_base bypass)
Nothing to stamp at all yields no_documents, non-zero - no green-on-vacuum
A write failing mid-set puts the originals back (write_back has no rollback)
The stamped set is exactly the .md half of REFRESH_SET (seven documents, five stamped)
Boundary round-trip: what is written parses back through the banner's own parser
integration: the adoption COMMIT carries the stamp (blobs read out of the commit, plus an independent git show)
integration: a writer between stamp and commit is caught, repaired by one amend, re-verified, and the amend overlays rather than replaces
integration: a commitless repository still onboards, and --verify-commit genuinely rejects a base-less commit (what makes Step H's skip load-bearing)
integration: the Group E remedy's first step reaches a clean tree
integration: --restore restores the evidence and preserves unrelated staged work
AC-6 the Group E remedy names a path that can actually clear the finding, on one line
AC-6 the remedy names only flags /shipwright-compliance accepts - validated against the SKILL, not a hardcoded list
AC-4 the handover names both refresh paths
AC-4 the handover says the evidence is NOT refreshed continuously (adjacent match, so an inverted banner fails)
Step H orders stamp -> commit -> verify, anchored on step headings rather than flag mentions
Step H stages AFTER stamping (the stamp writes the worktree; the commit records the index)
Step H distinguishes no_base (continue) from partial (stop)
AC-5 the generated CLAUDE.md carries the statement including the cadence, not merely the two commands

degraded.detail: The Stage-3 doubt-reviewer was spawned per the CLAUDE.md standing grant and was terminated mid-run by the account's MONTHLY SPEND LIMIT. No findings were produced and a retry is not available. Deliberately NOT substituted by a self-pass: the value of Stage 3 is adversarial FRESH context, which the author of the code cannot supply. Partial compensation, recorded so the gap is sized rather than waved away: the external code review ran on a separate billing path and returned the one medium finding both internal stages had missed (no_base bypassing the evidence-completeness gate). Five review passes ran in total.
